title: Beef Stew
description: A hearty beef stew with tender beef and a rich, flavorful broth.
instructions: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add the beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Add the cumin and cook for 1 minute.
Add the diced tomatoes and beef broth, and stir to combine.
Bring the stew to a boil, then cover and transfer to the oven.
Bake at 300°F for 2 1/2 hours, or until the beef is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
